item.title: These hearty, healthy soup recipes are great for the winter months
item.description: Need a nutritious and hearty soup recipe this winter? Try these recipes for lentil soup, borscht and pasta e fagioli.

item.title: After months of struggles, Sixers thrilled to see Jared McCain finally looking 'more like him'
item.description: Has Jared McCain finally arrived in his second NBA season? The 21-year-old's breakthrough performance on Tuesday night has inspired a lot of hope.

item.title: For its 800th episode, 'The Simpsons' has created a Philly-centric plot filled with guest stars
item.description: The 800th episode of 'The Simpson' airs Feb. 15 on FOX. The plot brings the Simpson family to Philadelphia and includes guest stars Quinta Brunson, Kevin Bacon, Questlove and Boyz II Men.

item.title: Philly DA Larry Krasner forms coalition with other district attorneys to prosecute federal officers who break state laws
item.description: Philadelphia DA Larry Krasner has formed a coalition with district attorneys in Virginia, Texas, Arizona and Minnesota to prosecute federal officers, like ICE agents, who commit state crimes.

item.title: Being a night owl may increase the risk of cardiovascular disease
item.description: People who consistently go to bed late at night and are active late in the day have a higher risk of stroke and heart attack than early risers, new research from the American Heart Association shows.

item.title: Joel Embiid, Paul George probable for Sixers-Kings on Thursday
item.description: Joel Embiid dominated in the first half of the Sixers' win over the Bucks on Tuesday and let his teammates take care of the rest. After only playing 29 minutes, what is Embiid's status?

item.title: Breeze Airways adds service out of Atlantic City International Airport
item.description: Breeze Airways will begin service out of Atlantic City International Airport this spring, becoming the third airline to offer year-round flights from the airport in South Jersey. Breeze will debut flights to Charleston, Raleigh-Durham, and Tampa.

item.title: If the Eagles aren't careful, they might just shut their contending window on themselves
item.description: It's the OC search, it's Jalen Hurts, it's Nick Sirianni, and it's paydays coming due. It takes a lot to keep the Super Bowl window open, and the Eagles already know it.

item.title: Lincoln, the eagle who soars at Birds games, went from picking through trash to starring in a Super Bowl commercial
item.description: A Budweiser Super Bowl commercial will feature Lincoln, the bald eagle that flies at Philadelphia Eagles home games. The American Eagle Foundation and a team of Clydesdale trainers helped get the animals to work together for the ad.

item.title: Eagles stay or go: Quarterback
item.description: Over the next few weeks, we'll be taking a position-by-position look at which players will likely be back with the Philadelphia Eagles in 2026, and which ones likely won't. We'll start with the quarterbacks.
